title: 16841 - 16841/P0457/001111
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Stored fault code(s) in Engine Kontrol Modülü
Possible fuel odor, especially near rear of vehicle after refueling
commonCauses: Fuel Tank Cap not closed properly
Fuel Tank Cap seal damaged, hardened, or missing
Evaporative Emission (EVAP) System leak (small to large)
Leak Detection Pump (LDP) or Leak Detection Module fault
Cracked or disconnected EVAP hoses or vapor lines
Damaged charcoal canister or vent valve
stepByStepSolution: Inspect Fuel Tank Cap and seal for damage, debris, or missing O-ring
Verify Fuel Tank Cap closes securely and clicks into place
Kontrol edin:  Fuel Filler Neck for damage or corrosion
Gerçekleştirin: Visual Inspection of Fuel Tank, EVAP hoses, canister, and fittings
Gerçekleştirin: EVAP leak test (with smoke test equipment)
Kontrol edin:  operation of Leak Detection Pump or system vent valve (if equipped)
technicalNotes: VAG grubu araçlarda bu kod görüldüğünde öncelikle yetkili diyagnoz cihazı (ODIS/VCDS) ile canlı değer testi yapılmalıdır.
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
